description: CoinGecko spot prices for up to 10 coins (by CoinGecko id, e.g. bitcoin,ethereum) in one currency, with 24h change. Prices are CoinGecko's aggregated spot prices; no history. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_coingecko_market_depth when you need CoinGecko per-exchange market depth for one coin: USD cost. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

ids.description: Comma-separated CoinGecko ids, up to 10 (e.g. bitcoin,ethereum)

vs.description: Quote currency code, e.g. usd, eur (default usd)

name: crypto_coingecko_spot_prices
title: CoinGecko spot prices for up to 10 coins in one currency
